rawFindings.title: resolving file glob patterns no longer filters out empty strings
rawFindings.explanation: The previous implementation filtered out empty string patterns before mapping them to glob patterns for processing. The current change removes that filtering step, so empty string patterns will be passed to the processing function which may cause unexpected behavior or errors during glob matching or file resolution.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the filtering of empty strings in resolveFileGlobPatterns by changing the line to: return patterns.filter(p => p.length).map(processPathExtensions);
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Calling resolveFileGlobPatterns with an array containing an empty string pattern (e.g., ['']) will now pass '' to the processPathExtensions function and may result in an incorrect or invalid glob pattern being generated, potentially causing errors during file globbing or unexpected results.
